summary: SOPHiA GENETICS SA filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten follow-on offering of ordinary shares (CHF 0.05 par value) listed on Nasdaq (symbol: SOPH). The offering is under a shelf registration statement (333-289266) with TD Cowen as lead book-running manager. The last sale price on June 15, 2026, was $5.01 per share. The filing does not provide the number of shares, price, or total proceeds; it appears to be a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No special-situation elements such as M&A, activist campaigns, restructuring, or spin-off are present.
